in_sanskrit.name: Itee
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Motherhood
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Itee एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Itee is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess Ishani, the goddess of motherhood and fertility. In Hindu mythology, Ishani is often depicted as a nurturing mother, holding her child in her arms. This name is believed to bring blessings of a healthy and happy child to new parents.
